newsitem.title: USA: News Corp seen announcing ASKyb partner.
newsitem.headline: News Corp seen announcing ASKyb partner.

text.p: News Corp Ltd's day-long presentation to anaylsts and portfolio managers at its 20th Century Fox studios in Los Angeles Monday will likely end with the announcement of a new partner for the company's U.S. satellite televison venture ASkyB, sources close to the company said.
Additional details were not immediately available and a New York-based spokeswoman for News Corp declined to comment.
In afternoon New York Stock Exchange trade, the American Depositary Receipts for News Corp were up 1/2 to 21-1/8.
